name: The Great Pellegrino
source:
The great phantom thief Pellegrino has died. Years ago, he had stolen something very important to you. Attempt to discreetly pry the location of your belonging from his spirit.

[From [url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/pellegrino]itch.io[/url]]
